mobbin:afb6188a-6313-41c8-a2b6-c19e7f876.summary: The user connects Google (or Outlook/iCloud), accepts Calendar/Email/Contacts permissions that include writing meetings, picks a main calendar and busy calendars, then sets weekly work hours.
steal: Permission wording states write behaviours: create meetings, sync events, block times (screen 2), which makes two-way explicit.
Main calendar is the default write target when creating events (screen 4).
Calendars that belong to you for availability are separate from holiday noise (screens 5 to 6).
You can skip calendar connect and still create meetings in-app (screen 1).
avoid: Email and Contacts scopes on the same screen may be heavier than Essentials needs for Outlook sync.
mobbin:afb6188a-6313-41c8-a2b6-c19e7f876.fit: Scheduling: best cheap pattern for Outlook/Google sync setup: provider, scopes, write-target calendar, busy calendars, work hours. Maps to conflict detection without building Motion's AI scheduler.
